items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: That was another one of my father's scholars.

ctx.x: Sudden death. Sudden death. It was a heart attack, yeah. He had worked at night up on the roof garden, there was a Peron band there. He was running the place at the time. And up until it was just about 11.30, they were getting ready for a break, because he spoke to me and he said, I want you to get home. You know, you have to start school early in the morning. So I said, okay. When I got home, I just did beat him home, to be true, for about maybe about 10 or 15 minutes, because when I heard the door, he was…

I was going to ask about Walter Brundy, another drummer. Walter Brundy was another one. I just faintly remember. That was another one of my father's scholars. He studied his and he never got to know Walter at all. He used to talk a lot about Walter. Yeah, well I met Walter just a little before
